styleGuide.description: Dark futuristic football control-room style, electric cyan and deep navy palette, clean high-contrast UI art, no text/logos/branding, cinematic lighting, subtle grain, soft bloom, crisp edges, suitable for desktop app UI composition.
globalPromptHints: Use consistent visual language across all assets.
Avoid text in all generated images.
Use transparent backgrounds for icons and overlays.
Keep icon stroke weight and perspective consistent.

Tileable dark blue glass-like card surface, soft inner glow, gentle top highlight, subtle edge depth, futuristic control-panel style, seamless texture, no artifacts
